p1: The leaders of the people made David their king. David was thirty years old, and he was king for forty years.
Then David brought the Lord’s ark, a holy box, into Jerusalem, his city. The ark showed the Lord was with His people.
David was so happy that he danced before the Lord with all his might! The people shouted for joy and blew trumpets.
p2: Later, the Lord sent David a message through Nathan, His prophet. The Lord promised, “Your family will have a king forever.” Many years later, Jesus was born into David’s family. Jesus is the King forever!
Jesus loves you. Tonight, dance your fingers on your blanket. Jesus is your King forever!
old: The Ark of the Covenant was Heavenly Father’s special holy box. David wanted to bring it to Jerusalem! He was SO happy and excited!
As the Ark came into the city, David couldn’t stop being happy! He danced and danced with all his might! He praised Heavenly Father!
David’s wife saw him dancing. She thought he looked silly for a king. She said, “Why are you dancing like that?” But David said, “I’m dancing for the Lord!”
David didn’t care what others thought. He just wanted to show Heavenly Father how much he loved Him! When we love God, we can be joyful and praise Him too!
